modifications: Baked source mesh scale into vertices, retained source +Z upright orientation.

Retained only meshes/materials/textures referenced by source object geoms, excluding region helper and unused alternate collision data.
Collision meshes retain the original convex decomposition; volume is computed from the signed tetrahedral sum.
